<thought>Using the most intense ESI peak (m/z 235.1395) as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈ 234.132 Da. The formula that best matches this mass is C₁₃H₁₈N₂O₂ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 234.1368 Da, within typical MS error).</thought>
<final_answer>C13H18N2O2</final_answer>
